## Purpose and use case {#purpose-and-use-case}

Lightweight speech noise reduction through the Sherpa streaming denoiser.

## Current availability {#current-availability}

Desktop builds can download and authenticate the required sherpa-onnx-node 2.0.1 engine for macOS arm64, Linux arm64, Linux x64, Windows arm64, Windows x64. Install this model and its required runtime through Model Manager, then run its task locally. These are supported build targets; consult the nightly test report for results on a particular package and machine.

## Use this model {#use-this-model}

Open **Effect → Noise Removal & Repair → Enhance Dialogue → Model** on a platform with the required native runtime. Local assistance runs in the desktop editor.

1. Select the audio to process.
2. Install GTCRN through Tools → Local Models → Manage Models, then choose it in Enhance Dialogue.
3. Apply the effect to the selection. Listen to the result and use Undo to restore the original if needed.

## Download and requirements {#download-and-requirements}

Model identity: `gtcrn`, version **1.0.0**.

Approximate model artifact download size: **523.08 KiB**. The required runtime adds to the first download if it is not already installed. Minimum system memory: **2 GiB**. This catalog requirement refers to total memory, not currently free memory. Inference also needs sufficient free memory, and installation needs working space; memory is not a speed guarantee.

Published platforms: macOS arm64, Linux arm64, Linux x64, Windows arm64, Windows x64. A matching downloadable runtime is also required.

On Windows, install the latest supported [Microsoft Visual C++ v14 Redistributable](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/windows/latest-supported-vc-redist?view=msvc-170) matching the desktop app: **x64** for an x64 build or **ARM64** for an ARM64 build. The native ONNX and Sherpa engines require these libraries; model and runtime downloads do not include them. Visual Studio itself is not required to use the app.

Tools → Model Manager downloads the published model artifacts and required runtime on first installation, and verifies their recorded SHA-256 digests. Processing uses the installed files locally. Open Storage and verification in Model Manager to inspect notices, repair an installation, or change the storage location.

<details id="what-the-packaged-test-checks">
<summary>What the desktop test checks</summary>

Case: `gtcrn-speech-enhancement`; operation: `speech-enhancement`.

Input: A public-domain excerpt from John F. Kennedy’s inaugural address resampled to mono 48 kHz, with added reproducible hiss.

Decoded audio must contain finite samples, preserve the expected audio geometry, differ from the input samples, and have a nonzero audible signal. Different file headers alone do not count as a change.

The nightly-with-tests package downloads real model artifacts and verified runtimes before inference. A required model missing from the catalog fails its case. Missing native engines fail on catalog-supported platforms. These costly checks run separately from the normal browser suite. A passing run confirms basic model execution and usable output structure; it does not establish perceptual quality or accuracy on your recording.

</details>

## Review the result {#review-the-result}

- Channels are processed independently; selection duration and channel count are preserved.
- Noise reduction may remove wanted detail. Listen after applying and use Undo to restore the original if needed.
- The test establishes basic inference and audio geometry, not perceptual quality.
